title.tag: A Pokémon fan game set in Hafnia
title.press: Press A or tap to start
intro.1:
Welcome to Hafnia: the first city in the world
run on 100% clean energy. Or so they say.
intro.2: Before we begin... what's your name?
p.bed.note:
A note on a paper bag: "The Professor called. Don't be late.
Cardamom buns inside. Jacket! — Mum"
p.mum.1:
Mum: Morning, {player}. I just got in from my shift.
Twelve hours at Rigshospitalet. I'm a zombie.
p.mum.2:
Mum: Professor Ørsted rang twice. Twice!
The Palm House, Botanical Garden. South, past the Lakes.
p.mum.3:
Mum: And take a jacket. It's Copenhagen.
It's always about to rain.
p.mum.heal:
Mum: Come here, let me look at your team.
...There. Right as rain.
p.tv: The TV: "...Vanguard Energy: Power without price."
p.stair.jensen.1:
Fru Jensen: Your friends are making a racket in the
courtyard. In my day we had manners. And bicycles.
p.stair.jensen.2: Fru Jensen: Well, we still have bicycles.
p.stair.jensen.daily:
Fru Jensen: Here, I found this in the stairwell.
It's not mine. Probably.
p.yard.lukas.1:
Lukas: Ninety-nine point nine percent grid uptime!
Vanguard's numbers are perfect this quarter.
p.yard.maja.1:
Maja: Perfect numbers are the ones I trust least.
Pass me that spanner?
p.yard.lukas.2:
Lukas: {player}! The Professor's giving out Pokémon
today. Three of them. Statistically, one is the best.
p.yard.maja.2:
Maja: Statistically, you're unbearable.
Come on, {player}. Last one to the Palm House is a Magikarp.
p.bridge.sign:
Sign: Dronning Louises Bro. Busiest bike bridge in the world.
Keep right. Signal. Don't stop in the lane.
p.bridge.tut.1: Commuters ride across in waves. Wait for a gap, then cross.
p.bridge.billboard: Billboard: VANGUARD ENERGY. Power without price.
p.bridge.maja:
Maja: Everything has a price. Somebody's just
not telling us who pays it.
p.r1.sign: Route 1: Søerne Path. ↑ Nørrebro ↓ Botanical Garden
p.r1.grass: Tall grass rustles. Without a Pokémon, it's wiser to stay on the path.
p.r1.mads.1:
Cyclist Mads: Whoa! Walking in the bike lane?!
Rule one: stay right. Rule two: signal before you stop.
p.r1.mads.2:
Mads: Rule three: get a Pokémon, then come back
and I'll teach you rule four. With a battle.
p.palm.door: The Palm House. Warm, wet air drifts out the door.
p.palm.maja:
Maja: Built in 1874. Prettiest building in the city.
Don't tell Lukas I said something nice.
p.orsted.1:
Professor Ørsted: Ah! The three of you! Up here,
on the catwalk. Mind the Bounsweet, she sprays.
p.orsted.2:
Ørsted: I study Bio-Resonance: how Pokémon and a city
can hum together. Like a song. Like a... where was I.
p.orsted.3:
Ørsted: Pokémon! Yes. Three colleagues who'd like
to see the city. Each one fits a part of it.
p.orsted.grass:
Ørsted: This one guards the King's Garden hedges.
A Grass-type. Very proper. Very serious about naps.
p.orsted.fire:
Ørsted: This one is warm as a Midsummer bonfire.
A Fire-type. Please don't let it near my ferns.
p.orsted.water:
Ørsted: This one swims the harbour baths all winter.
A Water-type. It thinks it's a seal. It's nearly right.
p.lukas.pick:
Lukas: Then I'll take {lstarter}. It has the type
advantage. Logically, it's the optimal choice.
p.maja.pick:
Maja: I'll take {mstarter}. I like the underdog.
Besides, it looked at me first.
p.orsted.dex:
Ørsted: And this: the Bio-Resonance Pokédex. It records
every Pokémon you meet. And it hums. Don't be alarmed.
p.orsted.items:
Ørsted: Five Poké Balls and two Potions.
Weaken a wild Pokémon first, then throw.
p.lukas.challenge:
Lukas: {player}! First battle. Right here on the catwalk.
I've already run the numbers.
p.lukas.win:
Lukas: Huh. My numbers were... next time.
Next time the maths will work.
p.lukas.lose:
Lukas: As predicted. Don't feel bad,
the sample size was small.
p.orsted.heal:
Ørsted: Marvellous! Both of you. Let me patch
everyone up. There.
p.bike.1:
Ørsted: One more thing. It's a prototype.
Rotom insisted.
p.bike.2: A cargo bike with a humming box on the front. {starter} hops in.
p.bike.rotom:
Rotom: Bzzt! Ready to ride! Hold B to go faster,
press the bike button to get on!
p.coil.1:
Rotom: Bzzt! I built a Resonance Coil into the box!
It charges up while you battle. Watch the pips!
p.coil.2:
Rotom: At three pips, I can send a Current through
one move. Once per battle. Make it count!
p.coil.tut: A wild Pokémon jumps out of the palms. Your Coil starts with 2 pips. Try a Current!
p.orsted.readings:
Ørsted: Langelinie readings again...
two degrees? In June? No, no, the sensor's off.
p.lukas.leave:
Lukas: I'm off to the Vanguard info centre.
They have a scholarship. See you around.
r1.jogger.intro:
Jogger Emil: Every morning, three laps of the Lakes.
And one battle. It's in the plan!
r1.jogger.line:
Emil: The swans here have right of way.
Don't argue with a swan. Ever.
r1.cyclist.intro:
Cyclist Sofie: My Pidgey and I are on a schedule.
Quick battle?
r1.cyclist.lose: Sofie: Late for work. Worth it.
r1.cyclist.line:
Sofie: Half the city bikes to work. The other
half bikes to work and complains about it.
r1.fisher.intro:
Fisher Bent: Shh. You'll scare the fish.
...There aren't any. So let's battle.
r1.fisher.lose: Bent: The fish are fine. I'm the one who's sad.
r1.fisher.line:
Bent: Forty years I've fished these lakes.
The ducks have gotten smarter. I have not.
r1.n.fisher.intro:
Fisher Ole: Night fishing is the best fishing.
Night battling is second best!
r1.n.fisher.lose: Ole: The Lotad think it's funny.
r1.n.student.intro:
Student Ida: I'm supposed to be studying.
Battling is studying. Sort of.
r1.n.student.lose: Ida: I'll tell my professor it was research.
r1.mads.challenge:
Mads: Rule four: if you've got a Pokémon,
you battle Mads! Ding ding!
r1.mads.lose:
Mads: Okay, okay. You know the lane.
Rule five: ring your bell. Always ring your bell.
r1.mads.after:
Mads: I've got eight rules in total.
Find me on other routes and I'll test you on the rest.
c1.terminal.1: A bike-lane barrier is stuck shut. A Vanguard terminal hums beside it.
c1.terminal.2: Rotom: Bzzt! Let me give it a jolt!
r1.sensor:
Man by the lake: I'm just looking at the lake.
Not at those Vanguard sensor buoys. No.
p.maja.challenge:
Maja: There you are! Lukas thinks battles are maths.
Let me show you they're stories.
p.maja.win:
Maja: Okay, that goes on the front page.
"Local kid beats zine editor."
p.maja.lose:
Maja: Front page: "Zine editor wins."
Go heal up, I'll wait. I won't, but go anyway.
p.maja.after.1:
Maja: Did you hear the Professor muttering?
Two degrees at Langelinie. In June.
p.maja.after.2:
Maja: Something in this city is off. And I'm
going to find out what. Watch this space.
p.news.1:
TV: "...harbour water at Langelinie measured at 2°C
today. Vanguard Energy says the sensors are faulty."
p.news.2: TV: "We spoke to some visitors at the statue."
p.news.tourist:
Tourist: We came all the way from Aarhus.
And the Mermaid is so tiny!
p.mum.night:
Mum: Tiny and freezing. Lovely.
Bed, {player}. Big day tomorrow. Probably.
c1.kilen.sign: Superkilen. Red Square · Black Square · Green Park
c1.tariq.1:
Tariq: Careful, wet paint! This is the Sound.
Our mural. Every kid in the workshop did a wave.
c1.kaas.1:
Commander Kaas: Mr. Haddad. Vanguard will install a grid
relay on this wall. It's for the public good.
c1.tariq.2:
Tariq: The public's standing right here, mate.
Ask them.
c1.tariq.3:
Tariq: Twenty-four hours. Fine. We finish it first.
But the Gym's shut today, I've got a mural to save.
c1.tariq.4:
Tariq: Go see the Professor. He rang the workshop
about his greenhouse. Something about the heating.
c1.orsted.cold:
Ørsted: My palms are shivering, {player}!
The heating's coming from the tunnels. Or it isn't.
c1.orsted.tunnels:
Ørsted: Would you look? I'd go myself, but my knees
and I have an agreement about ladders.
c1.tunnel.valve.ok: Steam hisses back into the pipe the right way.
c1.tunnel.pipe:
A copper-and-white pipe stamped VANGUARD.
It's cold, and it's pulling heat away from the Garden.
c1.eng1.intro:
Vanguard Engineer: Authorised personnel only!
You're not authorised. I can tell by your face.
c1.eng1.lose:
Engineer: This is a routine maintenance tunnel.
Routinely. Maintained.
c1.eng2.intro:
Vanguard Engineer: The pipe's working exactly as
designed. Don't ask me what it's designed to do.
c1.eng2.lose: Engineer: I just install them. I don't read the memo.
c1.swarm: Grimer pour out of a drain, drawn by the warmth!
c1.orsted.back:
Ørsted: Warm again! You're a marvel. A pipe running
backwards, you say? ...How odd. How very odd.
c1.orsted.tm:
Ørsted: Take this. TM Bullet Seed. A TM can be
used again and again. Unlike my patience for ladders.
c1.mural.tariq:
Tariq: Four colours left: green, gold, silver, purple.
Ask around Nørrebro. People here share.
c1.paint.green:
Gardener on Den Grønne Sti: Hedge-green? Take the
whole tin. Bring back the tin. And a Pidgey feather.
c1.paint.gold: Skater Yusuf: Gold? Beat me and it's yours.
c1.paint.silver:
Courier at the garage: Silver for bike frames.
Maja says you're alright. That's rare.
c1.paint.purple:
A Toxel is chewing a purple paint can in the alley.
It lets go when you offer an Oran Berry.
c1.mural.done.1: Tariq: That's it. Look at it.
c1.mural.done.2:
The mural shows a great sea creature with its mouth open.
No sound comes out.
c1.mural.done.3:
Tariq: I dreamed it. Don't ask.
Right. Gym's open. Come and get stung.
c1.gym.sign: Superkilen Gym. Leader: Tariq. "Keep the squares loud."
c1.gym.guide:
Gym guide: Hit the spray switches in the mural's
colour order and the smog vents shut. Green first!
c1.gym.wrong: Pfssht! The vents puff smog. The switches reset.
c1.gym.skater.intro: Skater: Red Square's ours. You skate or you sit.
c1.gym.muralist.intro:
Muralist: Smeargle and I painted half this wall.
Want to see the other half?
c1.gym.muralist.lose: Muralist: Okay, you can sign it. Small, in the corner.
c1.tariq.intro.1:
Tariq: This square is for the people who live here.
Not for relays. Not for anyone who wants to own it.
c1.tariq.intro.2:
Tariq: Show me you'll fight for something, {player}.
My Poison-types don't hold back.
c1.tariq.last: Tariq: Last one. Make it loud!
c1.tariq.lose: Tariq: Respect. You fight like you belong here.
c1.tariq.badge:
Tariq: This is the Spray Badge. Wear it where
people can see it.
c1.tariq.tm:
Tariq: And this: TM Acid Spray. Melts defences.
Like a good mural.
c1.tariq.bell:
Rotom: Bzzt! A bell! Ding!
Weaker wild Pokémon will scatter in bike lanes now!
c1.tariq.obey: Traded Pokémon up to Lv 25 will now obey you.
c1.lukas.1:
Lukas: Badge one. Not bad. Look what I got.
The Lindholm Scholarship. Vanguard's top programme.
c1.lukas.2:
Lukas: Director Lindholm says people like me will
keep this city running when the sea comes up.
c1.lukas.3:
Lukas: Let's see if the scholarship was a good
investment. Battle!
c1.lukas.lose: Lukas: An outlier. You're an outlier.
c1.relay: That evening the relay goes up, right over the painted sea.
c1.tariq.relay: Tariq: They didn't even wait the twenty-four hours.
c1.blackout: Click. Every light in Nørrebro goes out.
c1.roof: On the rooftop: a yellow-and-black oilskin. Then nothing.
c1.mum.dark:
Mum: Candles are in the drawer. This city, honestly.
A hundred percent clean energy and no lights.
c2.strog.sign:
Strøget. One of Europe's longest shopping streets.
Bikes walked, please.
c2.torv.stall.1:
Stall owner: Smørrebrød! Rye bread, spread, topping.
Three layers. Never two. Never four.
c2.torv.stall.2:
Stall owner: Here, a free recipe card. The Hafnian way.
Collect them and you'll eat like a king.
c2.rund.tycho:
Astronomer: The Round Tower is closed for
"routine maintenance". Go and look at something else.
c2.rund.tycho.2: Astronomer: Not the sky. The sky is mine today.
c2.busker.intro:
Busker Viggo: Every song needs an audience.
You'll do. Battle!
c2.busker.lose:
Viggo: Bravo. Take this, TM Round.
A song sounds better when everyone joins in.
c2.busker.line:
Viggo: Funny. The old fishermen's songs are all about
something in the water singing back.
c2.tourist.intro:
Tourist Gerd: We're from Aarhus! Battle us,
then tell us where the Mermaid is.
c2.tourist.lose: Gerd: Langelinie, you say? We'll go tomorrow.
c2.guard.intro:
Royal Guard Frederik: I am on duty.
I am also on lunch. Battle me quickly.
c2.guard.lose: Frederik: Back to standing very still.
c2.student.intro:
Student Anders: My thesis is on Psychic types
in urban spaces. Help me with the data?
c2.ny.sign: Nyhavn. The old harbour. Mind the cobbles.
c2.ny.maja.1:
Maja: {player}! You're here too? I got a tip
something's going down by the canal. Look!
c2.ny.boom:
BOOM. A Vanguard buoy in the canal pops like a cork.
Water everywhere.
c2.ny.freja.1: Woman in oilskin: Listen to the water!
c2.ny.deck.1: Deckhand: Nobody follows the Captain. Nobody!
c2.ny.deck.2: Deckhand: Two of you? Fine. Two of us.
c2.ny.maja.2: Maja: You and me, {player}. I'll take the left one.
c2.ny.maja.3:
Maja: Black Fleet. Yellow-and-black oilskins.
Same as the rooftop in Nørrebro.
c2.ny.maja.4:
Maja: They're headed for Refshaleøen. The harbour bus
goes there. Come on!
c2.ny.sailor.line:
Sailor Henning: Sixty years I've sailed out of Nyhavn.
Never seen the harbour this cold. Never.
c2.ny.tourist.line:
Tourist Hans-Peter: We finally saw the Mermaid.
She's so tiny! Gerd cried. From the cold.
c2.bus.bodil.1:
Captain Bodil: All aboard the harbour bus! Next stop,
Refshaleøen. Hold on to your hats. And your Pokémon.
c2.bus.bodil.2:
Bodil: Feel that chill off the water? Twenty years
I've driven this boat. It's never been like this.
c2.dock.sign: Refshaleøen. Former shipyard. Keep out. (Nobody does.)
c2.dock.crane: A crane console. Move the hook? ← → to slide, A to drop.
c2.dock.crane.ok: The container lands with a CLANG. A path opens.
c2.dock.deck.intro:
Deckhand: The sea is in pain, and you're
helping the ones who hurt it!
c2.dock.deck.lose: Deckhand: You don't even know what you're fighting for.
c2.ivar.1:
Bosun Ivar: That's far enough, kid. I built ships
in this yard for thirty years. Then they closed it.
c2.ivar.2: Ivar: Nobody closes this one. Hup!
c2.ivar.lose:
Ivar: Hah! Strong arms. Strong heart, too.
Go on, then. The Captain wants a word.
c2.freja.1: Captain Freja: So. You're the one who keeps turning up.
c2.freja.2:
Freja: I could keep you here. I won't.
I'm not the one hurting this city.
c2.freja.3:
Freja: The water at Langelinie is freezing.
Ask yourself why the company that heats your flat doesn't care.
c2.freja.4: She drops a yellowed page as she leaves.
c2.log.1:
The Lighthouse Log, page 1: "June 1961. Trekroner.
The singing was faint tonight. I hope it's the wind."
c2.log.got: {player} found a page of the Lighthouse Log! (1/10)
c2.nail.1:
Bosun Ivar: Here. Captain said to give you this.
A copper hull nail from the old ships.
c2.nail.2:
Ivar: Copper sheathing kept the worms off the hulls.
Kept the ships whole. Maybe it'll do the same for you.
c2.nail.3:
Rotom: Bzzt! Copper! I can make Patina armour with this!
Tougher hide, but it seals the held item.
c2.enforcer.overcharge: The Enforcer's Rotom crackles red: Overcharge! (first Vanguard use)
c2.chr.maja.1:
Maja: Welcome to my favourite part of the city.
Don't run, don't take photos of people. Photos of Pokémon, fine.
c2.night.market: The Freetown night market: fairy lights, stalls, music.
c2.knud.1:
Old Knud: You look hungry. Everybody looks hungry.
Sit. Eat. Have I told you about the eel of '79?
c2.knud.2:
Knud: Three layers. Rye, butter, herring.
...When there's herring. There hasn't been much.
c2.knud.rod:
Knud: Here. My old rod. The lakes still have fish,
even if the harbour forgets.
c2.overhear.1:
Deckhand: Alva's keeping the boats
safe. Nobody checks the houseboats.
c2.overhear.2: Maja: ...Didn't hear that. Neither did you.
c2.orsted.scan:
Ørsted: {player}! I've sent your
Pokédex an update. It hums near hidden things now!
c2.scan.got: The Pokédex learned the Bio-Resonance scan!
c2.alva.1:
Alva: Careful on the planks. The moat's choking.
Algae everywhere, and it's June. Too warm here, freezing there.
c2.alva.2:
Alva: Warm water from those pipes. Vanguard's outflow.
Can you help my barges? Push the floating booms together.
c2.alva.done:
Alva: You've a knack for boats. Come by the Gym.
I'll give you a proper test.
c2.gym.sign: Stadsgraven Gym. Leader: Alva. "Swimmable for every child."
c2.gym.guide:
Gym guide: Rotate the solar mirrors on the houseboat
roofs. Sun on a lily makes it bloom into a bridge.
c2.gym.gardener.intro:
Gardener: Plants grow toward light.
So do challengers. Battle!
c2.gym.christ.intro:
Christianite: Peace, love and Petilil.
Mostly Petilil.
c2.alva.intro.1:
Alva: The canals were filthy when I was a girl.
Now kids swim in them. That took twenty years.
c2.alva.intro.2:
Alva: I don't give up on things that take time.
Neither should you.
c2.alva.badge:
Alva: The Lily Badge. And TM Magical Leaf.
It never misses. Neither do the weeds.
c2.alva.net:
Rotom: Bzzt! A Basket Net! Ride past hedges
to pick berries and items!
c2.alva.obey: Traded Pokémon up to Lv 30 will now obey you.
c2.alva.secret:
Alva: If anyone asks about my houseboats...
they're just houseboats.
c2.dusk.1: Dusk. The streetlights on the bridge flicker... and die.
c2.dusk.freja.1:
Freja: Don't be scared of the dark.
Be scared of what keeps the lights on.
c2.dusk.freja.2:
Freja: Ask Vanguard what's screaming underneath
the harbour every time you turn on the lights.
c2.dusk.freja.3: Freja: Let's see if you're worth telling.
c2.freja.win: Freja: Not yet, then. But you will be.
c2.dusk.lukas.2:
Lukas: She's a terrorist. She blacked out half the
city. And you were just... talking to her?
c2.dusk.lukas.3: Lukas: You're helping her. Battle me. Now.
c2.lukas2.lose: Lukas: This isn't over. The data's on my side.
c2.lukas2.win: Lukas: See? Vanguard keeps people safe. That's the point.
c2.dusk.maja.1: Maja picks a folded note off the rail and pockets it.
c2.dusk.maja.2:
Maja: Come on. Let's go home before the lights
come back on and somebody asks questions.
c2.end.1:
Behind you, the lights come back on. Somewhere under
the harbour, something is still singing. Barely.
c2.end.2: Copper & Current · End of the demo. Thank you for playing!
c2.end.3:
Your save is kept. The story continues in Chapter 3:
The White Butchery.
